meta.title: Laura Pimiä — design engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Laura Pimiä, a design engineer in Helsinki working across front end, UX and print.

about.title: Laura Pimiä
about.photoCaption: Enjoying a funny little drink in Harajuku, Tokyo.
about.lead: I'm a design engineer based in Helsinki. I started my career in 2014 as a web developer working with PHP and Javascript, Angular v1 and jQuery, ended up settling with React and any side dish brought to the table.
about.paragraph1: I sit between design and front end. In my work that means I am the connecting cable between design and development, and I am the person who picks up the slack when the design team needs to focus on more burning things. I'm a big design systems advocate for this reason.
about.paragraph2: Outside work I am a freelance graphic designer with experience in print and apparel design. I also play Dungeons and Dragons actively and travel to Japan annually. And I won't shut up about it.

work.title: Client work
work.intro: I work as a senior consultant in the Design Engineers tribe at Siili Solutions and I've been here since 2021 putting my spoon in many project pies. In total my career as a consultant has lasted 10 years by now, so I've gathered quite a lot of mileage from different industries. Clients have been both public sector and commercial, and I pride myself upon my ability to learn and adapt to new business domains quickly and getting to know people as fast as possible. Below you can find my most recent client projects from the last 5 years. If you want to hear more about my older work, just hit me up!

timeline.publicText: Public sector front ends: accessible React applications built to survive long service lifecycles and multiple content teams.
timeline.commercialText: Commercial products: design systems, component libraries, and the REST and GraphQL integration layers behind them.

projects.title: A public maritime services portal
projects.summary: A service created for a Finnish maritime authority to comply with the EU regulations of harmonizing port operations across member states. I joined the project around 8 months before release to help with the ongoing work of finishing up the user-facing interface and its missing features. I took part in the usability of the forms, navigation and implementing new features and views while doing design work according to the already existing design language. I received significant praise from my work from the team and the client regarding the usability of the long format forms and their fluidity.

projects.title: A realtor's portal
projects.summary: I took part in the final stages of developing a realtor's portal for managing real estate listings. My role was to implement media handling features that would be both intuitive to use and performance efficient. I worked tightly alongside both the design operations and the API crew to produce the outcome of a easy to use and performant media handling system.

projects.title: A data visualization dashboard for a private company
projects.summary: A B2B user-facing service for a private company to visualize data from their backend systems in a readable and efficient way. Besides my main project where I constructed a data visualization dashboard, I took part in improving their design system process and component library implementation.

projects.title: A registry system for a public service
projects.summary: Once again I joined the tail end of a project, ended up staying way longer than the initial few months of seasonal assistance. I took it upon myself to write a massive load of tests and nearly rewrote the forms to be more reliable with their behavior. The product turned out to be a great success after release with barely any bugs present. Introduced query caching for the frontend.

projects.title: E-commerce for a Finnish retailer
projects.summary: A quick stint slamming some tickets for a storefront website. Focusing on constructing the main webpage with all of its user interaction design and development. Closely collaborating with the design department to plan and implement reusable components.

projects.title: A catalog system for Finnish traveling agencies
projects.summary: A complex cataloguing system created for a corporation working under the Ministry of Employment and the Economy. Implemented a design system for easier component reuse and development after the project struggled with remnants of an old bootstrap library and forked components.

graphics.title: Illustrations and graphic design
graphics.intro: I'm the principal designer for a Finnish convention centered around Japanese pop culture hosting 3000 visitors biannually in both June and January. My work spans across 16 years at this point, but here are some of the more recent works. If you're wondering about the seals... that's what we affectionally call the volunteers and use as our recognizable iconography as the marine theme also fits with our venue being located right by the Vesijärvi lake. Seals are so dear to us we have also arranged a sizable donation to the Saimaa ringed seal conservation work in 2026. Out of principle, I do not use generative AI for my illustrations at all.

projects.title: 'Kaminari' - Desucon 2026 beer can label
projects.summary: Label artwork for the convention's own beer made in collaboration with Ant Brewery with a spicy-lime flavor profile, printed wrap-around.

projects.title: Melon Soda - Desucon 2026 T-shirt
projects.summary: Large front print for the convention's own t-shirt sold to visitors and given as a gift to volunteer workers.

projects.title: 'Kanpai!' - Desucon Frostbite 2026 beer can label
projects.summary: Winter counterpart to the Desucon can: same format, colder palette. Collaboration with Ant Brewery. Based on the theme 'Kanpai!', i.e. cheers! enthusiastically shouted at Japanese bars.

projects.title: Kuuttimopo - Desucon Frostbite 2026 T-shirt graphic
projects.summary: Large front print for the convention's own t-shirt sold to visitors and given as a gift to volunteer workers. Received very enthusiastic praise for its references to the cult classics 'Initial D' and Kurkkumopo. Also used as a tote bag print.

projects.title: Embroidered patches
projects.summary: Design for the embroidered patch sold to visitors as official Desucon merchandise. Based on the theme 'Natsu Matsuri', i.e. Japanese summer festivals and a pastiche to Hokusai's 'The Great Wave of the Lahti bay'.

projects.title: Vinyl sticker sheet
projects.summary: A sheet of vinyl stickers compiled of the t-shirt images I have made for the convention from the previous three years.

hobby.title: Built for no client
hobby.intro: I'm going to keep it a buck fifty - after I close my laptop for the day, my free time goes mostly into creative projects and meeting dear friends. But I do dabble into some side projects here and there. Here are my current toy boxes.

projects.title: DMScreen
projects.summary: I'm currently working on a content managing tool for game masters to help organize and manage their Dungeons and Dragons sessions. Past the concept planning stage and currently building its design on Figma. Interviewing experienced game masters to search for the most essential features they would need for a fluid game session. Key feature being managing the player-facing screen and its content. Taking this as a chance to learn more about automating design systems and component development via automatic agentic tools. Planned release date is Q4 2026 with biweekly checkups with a friend who kindly took the role of a client.

projects.title: Satchel UI
projects.summary: Satchel UI is the component kit I'm using to develop my DMScreen project, but also the follow-up projects to it. The plan is to create a monorepo ecosystem powered by Nx to host also a player-centered campaign management tool.

about.label: Summary
paragraphs: 10+ years of developing, Typescript, React, SCSS tied together with a UX bow, aided with the appropriate use of AI models and figuring out their possibilities, fullstacking when necessary. Always willing to expand my skillset and stay curious about the world around me whether it's a new business domain, technology or the people inhabiting it. Seen a lot over the years!

I have a background in developing and programming interfaces for projects for various industries with a wide array of users. User experience and service design are my biggest passions, something I truly do feel a calling for. I consider creating user interfaces artistry not only due to pretty pictures and colors, but also due to an intuitive experience and availability for all kinds of users to remove the friction between them and technology. I want to understand the product's purpose as thoroughly as possible.

entries.title: Senior Consultant — Siili Solutions
entries.description: Part of the Design Engineers tribe. Acting as a senior level developer in projects requiring advanced knowledge of front end ecosystems and user experience design. Projects have included both public sector and commercial clients. React.js, Typescript, SCSS and both REST and GraphQL based interfaces. Design System work. Various component libraries such as Bootstrap, MaterialUI, Ant Design and more. Plenty of form developing war stories. Picking up various genAI tools to better my work as we speak.

entries.title: Consultant — Netlight
entries.description: I specialized in Front end/web development and user experience design, using pure javascript, typescript, React.js and other various front-end development technologies to create and improve user interfaces. Projects involved embedded systems, MaaS interfaces, user-targeted tools for financial industries and e-commerce.

entries.title: Front end developer — Great Apes
entries.description: Various Front End oriented projects for the web. Websites, applications, even games. Javascript, SASS, CSS, Canvas, PHP, Wordpress.

entries.title: IT Assistant — Verohallinto, Finnish Tax Administration
entries.description: A temporary position for the IT side of the tax inspection in a project while finishing my studies. Using data extraction tools, handful script creation for the good of the nation and taking part in the planning strategies and helping out with anything that requires IT-related knowledge.

entries.title: Inspector general — Verohallinto
entries.description: A summer internship job at Verohallinto. Testing, documenting, creating education material and using software meant for the tax administration employees. Database organizing. My position required a good knowledge of the architecture and behavior of web sites.

entries.title: Web Developer — Givget Oy
entries.description: Creating campaign sites with participating forms and other features using HTML, Javascript, CSS and PHP. Development of CMS services and a social media site and other IT related tasks of the company.

groups.title: Front end
groups.text: I'm very curious about almost anything front end related, and I'm always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn. React.js is my bread and butter and I'm in love with the framework, but I wouldn't say no to learning of alternatives.

groups.title: Systems
groups.text: Currently wracking my brain to figure out how to integrate AI into design system work. The field is moving very fast and I'm eager to see where it ends up after the dust settles. I am not the person who will add AI just because it's the buzzword right now, I am more interested in its actual strengths to help us ship better products.

groups.title: Design
groups.text: I consider myself a creative person first and a programmer second. I'm always looking for new ways to express myself and I'm eager to see where my ideas take me, and that includes service design and planning how the user interfaces with the design.

contact.heading: Where to find me
contact.text: Hit me up via an e-mail or a LinkedIn message even if you just want to chat about work, design, art, Dungeons and Dragons or traveling to Japan. I simply like meeting new people.
